# Test arithmetic operations
.global asm_add_test

    ret

asm_shift_test:
    movl $1, %eax
    shll $4, %eax
    shrl $2, %eax
    sarl $1, %eax
    ret

# Test compare and set
.global asm_cmp_test
asm_cmp_test:
    movl $5, %eax
    cmpl $5, %edi
    sete %al
    movzbl %al, %eax
    ret

# Test bit operations
.global asm_bit_test
asm_bit_test:
    movl $0xF0, %eax
    andl $0xFF, %eax
    orl $0x0F, %eax
    xorl $0x55, %eax
    ret

# Test memory operations
.global asm_mem_test
asm_mem_test:
    pushq %rbp
    movq %rsp, %rbp
    subq $16, %rsp
    movl $42, -4(%rbp)
    movl -4(%rbp), %eax
    leave
    ret

# Test conditional jumps
.global asm_jmp_test
asm_jmp_test:
    xorl %eax, %eax
    testl %edi, %edi
    jz .Lzero
    movl $1, %eax
    jmp .Ldone2
.Lzero:
    movl $2, %eax
.Ldone2:
    ret

# Test byte/word/dword operations

    movzbq %al, %rax
    movw $0x1234, %ax
    movzwl %ax, %eax
    ret
